describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side view standing on a small patch of bare ground with sparse dry vegetation. It has a stout, low-slung, quadrupedal body with a broad flattened head at the right end, a thick tapering tail extending to the right behind the body, and four short thick limbs ending in splayed clawed feet. The dorsal surfaces of the head, back, sides, and tail are covered in overlapping rounded dark gray-brown scales with lighter edges, while the throat, belly, and underside of the tail are smooth and pale cream with faint transverse banding. Just behind the head on the neck are several feathery, filament-fringed stalks protruding outward. The head has a blunt snout with a small reddish nostril, a large round eye with a dark pupil and light iris, and a closed mouth with a pale lower jaw. The overall appearance is that of a heavily armored amphibian-like animal.

describe.description: A stout quadrupedal creature with a salamander-like body standing in profile facing right. It has a broad flat head with a rounded snout, a large prominent eye, and a wide mouth. Behind the head are multiple long feathery external gill stalks. The entire dorsal surface from the top of the head across the back and onto the top of the long tapering tail is covered in large overlapping dark gray-brown rounded scales, while the throat, belly and underside of the tail are smooth and pale cream. It stands on four thick smooth gray sprawling legs ending in broad splayed clawed feet.
